kind: post hoc diagnostic, written after the amendment 1 evidence and before its own measurement
trigger: Amendment 1 localises the failure in the single learned flight from panel senders: in E2 T1 region C the light -> panel -> patch family is 18.8 % of what the region reads, the frozen operators deliver 2.8 % / 3.6 % of their reading through it (signed error -0.116 / -0.110 of total radiance), and the global term adds +0.050 / +0.064. The free-factor fit on that geometry still leaves 49-68 % of the deficit (INDETERMINATE). Open question (brief C2): does the frozen geometry-state relation (512 stratified rays per patch, 8 per incident bin, hit patch + outgoing bin) lose the sharp-sender flight by sampling / quantisation, or is the relation adequate and its learned use insufficient?
measurement: for Lambert receiver patches and panel senders, the irradiance of the 2-event family computed (BIN) through the deployed state rays from the path-traced once-scattered radiance of the panel averaged per (patch, outgoing bin), and (RAY) through the same rays from the exact radiance at each hit point; compared with the path-traced truth (SPLIT e2_p) by the importance-weighted reading of the region and at patch level (patches carrying > 0.2 % of the region importance)

rules.ADEQUATE: BIN and RAY both reproduce the truth's importance-weighted reading within 20 % and with patch-level relative RMS <= 0.3 in every primary case where the family carries > 2 % of the reading: the relation can carry the flight; the failure is its learned use
rules.SAMPLING-LIMITED: RAY (exact sender radiance, deployed rays) misses the reading by > 20 % or has patch-level relative RMS > 0.5 in every such case: the ray count of the state relation cannot carry a sharp sender lobe
rules.BIN-LIMITED: RAY is adequate and BIN is not: the 64 outgoing bins at the sender lose the lobe

gate: SAMPLING-LIMITED or BIN-LIMITED place the cause in the frozen state / angular budget (not admissible to change: state rays, bins); ADEQUATE leaves the learned mapping (generator / training) as the cause with no bounded admissible correction shown. In every case the batch stops at attribution.
